notes.title: Diesel Guns. Alpha v0.9.3 Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
* Fix: sniper aiming mode
* Fix: switching camera mode with "Z" key
* Fix: Camera FOV in "Rampage" mode
* Fix: switching weapons with number keys
* Fix: mortar alt-fire (wasn't able to see targets)
* Fix: now the hover vehicle is lower
* Changed: the location of respawn points in "Bomb" mode
* New: the launch trailer is played when the game starts

notes.title: Diesel Guns Update Alpha v0.8.9.0: New game modes and vehicles.
notes.notes:
[b]Diesel Guns Update Alpha v0.8.9.0:  New game modes and vehicles.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8878083/ab3237ab2582cfd5ad1b88d36b3002722018c70c.jpg[/img]

Release notes:

Added new game modes:
[list]
[*] Last Hero - Only one life, but with each enemy killed, the player's car becomes stronger. In the end, there should be only one.
[*] Team Defmatch - In the limited time, you need to collect more frags than the enemy team.
[*] Dominator - Frags are counted only for kills while you carrying the flag. 
[/list]

New vehicle: Tow Truck - Pickup
New vehicle: Step Van - Van
New vehicle: Spark - Supercar
